notes: Pose images are key pose references, not frame-by-frame character animations.
Origin is at foot/ground center. Individual cutouts use joint_pivot_hint; validate joint overlap when assembling the rig.
Fire frames share canvas, scale, and bottom-center origin. Use 8 fps loop; phase timing may be tuned by programmer.
E01 tiles have a 24px shared dirt boundary; all 256 tile pairs have exact matching horizontal and vertical edge pixels. Art direction still requires visual review.
